Three.js r170 (0.170.0), MIT license.
Files downloaded from the official package distributed through unpkg:
https://unpkg.com/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js
https://unpkg.com/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/loaders/SVGLoader.js
https://unpkg.com/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js

The r170 three.module.js build is self-contained; no three.core.js is required.
Both example modules import only from "three". Map "three" to this local module.
